## Package

Which `@triforge/*` package should this live in? If you're not sure, check the "What
Belongs Where" table in the root `CLAUDE.md`, or leave this blank and we'll help place it.

## Blender equivalent (if any)

If this mirrors a Blender node/modifier/feature, name it — Triforge matches Blender's
naming exactly where an equivalent exists.

## What problem does this solve

What are you trying to build, and what's missing today?

## Proposed API (optional)

```ts
// how you imagine calling it
const thing = new SomeNode({ param: 1 })
```

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds you're using today, or other approaches you considered.
